description:
Copper Point of Sale is open on the Windows desktop showing the main POS register screen. The system has existing inventory items pre-loaded from a real retail product catalog.

Your task:
1. Navigate to the Menu/Items management area (use the 'Menu' or 'Items' button in the toolbar, or go to View > Menu Items).
2. Click 'Add' or 'New' to create a new menu item.
3. Enter the following product details:
   - Item Name: 'Organic Green Tea 20pk'
   - Category: 'Beverages'
   - Price: '$8.99'
   - Cost: '$4.50'
   - Description: 'Premium organic green tea, 20 tea bags per box'
4. Save the new item by clicking 'Save' or 'OK'.
5. Verify the new item appears in the items list.
